claims: A-Train (Reggie Franklin) is a character from the TV series The Boys.
A-Train dies in the premiere episode of Season 5 of The Boys.
Homelander snaps A-Train's neck in the woods.
A-Train saves Hughie from a Vought camp.
A-Train laughs at Homelander during a final confrontation.
A-Train had recently defected from The Seven to help Starlight and The Boys.
A-Train's defection made him a target.
Jessie T. Usher discussed A-Train's death.
Jessie T. Usher noted that A-Train's death was a "long time coming".
Jessie T. Usher noted that A-Train's death was a planned end for the character
